style.toneOfVoiceUnformatted: This HOMCOM 6ft artificial Christmas tree features a snowy design, making it a beautiful and festive addition to your home for the winter season. Made from flame-retardant plastic, this slim tree is both durable and safe for indoor use. It comes in three easy-to-assemble pieces—simply fit them together and mould the auto-open hinged branches to your desired shape. The tree is designed with a strong steel base to keep it weighted and stable. Standing at 6ft tall, it’s perfect for larger spaces. With 600 tips, it offers a realistic, full appearance. The flame-retardant branches provide an extra layer of safety, though it’s important to keep the tree away from naked flames. The tree’s dimensions are 80cm diameter x 180cm height, and it’s crafted from a combination of steel, PE, and plastic. Please note, it is recommended to take 30-45 minutes to shape the tree for optimal results, and this tree is intended for indoor use only. Tree item label: 830-862V00GN.
